questions.question_text: Trace the step-by-step logic used by the four brothers to convince the King of their innocence.
questions.correct_answer: Each brother presented a distinct clue: Shiv Datt explained the three strong footprints and one dragged mark showing lameness; Ram Datt cited leaves eaten on only one side showing one-eyed blindness; Dev Datt pointed to leaf gaps showing a missing tooth; Har Datt noted insects on spilled goods showing wheat and honey. Together, these logical connections proved their guiltlessness and demonstrated supreme observational skill.
